profiles.name: Arthur Joseph Kurup
profiles.position: Minister of Natural Resources and Environmental Sustainability
profiles.description: Arthur Joseph Kurup is Minister of Natural Resources and Environmental Sustainability. He represents Pensiangan, Sabah, in the Dewan Rakyat. He is a member of Parti Bersatu Rakyat Sabah (PBRS).

profiles.name: Ramanan Ramakrishnan
profiles.description: Ramanan Ramakrishnan is Minister of Human Resources. He represents Sungai Buloh, Selangor, in the Dewan Rakyat. He is a member of Parti Keadilan Rakyat (PKR).

milestones.title: Table the Climate Change Bill, subject to Cabinet approval
milestones.description: Arthur said the Climate Change Bill was intended for the current parliamentary sitting once Cabinet approval was obtained.
milestones.progress_note: His update reports drafting approval in principle and completed state-government engagement. This supports ongoing preparation, not first reading, passage or commencement. The tabling condition remains explicit; a firm unconditional deadline and completion percentage were not established.

milestones.title: Reach a 35% skilled workforce by 2030
milestones.description: KESUMA’s account of Ramanan’s 2026 address states a 35% skilled-workforce target by 2030, supported by TVET and targeted training.
milestones.progress_note: His August update describes continuing workforce-skills programmes. Programme offers and training capacity do not establish the national skilled-workforce share. The target remains in progress with no numerical completion assigned.

milestones.title: Provide AI-learning access for 100,000 youths
milestones.description: Ramanan endorsed the shared AI for the People initiative targeting 100,000 youths aged 18–30 and broader access to AI skills.
milestones.progress_note: The report describes the new initiative and related workforce programmes. It does not establish 100,000 participants completing the prescribed modules. Separate MyMahir training capacity is not substituted for this target; outcome status, deadline and completion remain unknown.

party_parents_added.name: Parti Bersatu Rakyat Sabah
party_parents_added.description: A component party of Barisan Nasional (BN).

methodology: Editorial records of attributable commitments and dated evidence, not endorsements or independently audited performance scores. Promise dates use explicitly stated event dates where available. Year/month-only target dates use end-of-period markers, not an invented exact-day promise. Sector ratios, budget allocations and announcements are not completion scores.

missing_fields.completion_percentages: NULL unless a dated metric or transparent calculation is explicitly documented.
missing_fields.additional_milestones: Up to two per person in this initial pass; unimported additional commitments are not_researched_to_completion, not proof none exist.
